scope: Native release center on this host; separate fixture process contains both TLS protocol agents and is excluded from center counters

methodology.process: ps -p <owned center PID> -o rss= -o time=. RSS KiB converted to bytes; CPU is cumulative process time delta divided by monotonic sampled wall time, as percent of one core. Raw samples include command overhead. Peak is the largest sampled RSS, not a guaranteed instantaneous peak. CPU ps precision is host-dependent (normally 10ms).
methodology.browser: Fresh Chromium context, trust restricted to generated fixture CA SPKI. PerformanceResourceTiming encodedBodySize/decodedBodySize/transferSize are browser-reported response body and transfer byte counts; transfer includes response headers and may be zero for cache hits. CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage is JS heap without forced GC. DOM nodes from Memory.getDOMCounters and elements/rows from selectors.
methodology.workload: One login KDF, two connected TLS protocol agents, two open cleanup tabs, fast UI preview, full protocol preview with live UI observer, UI cancellation, history with 51 synthetic receipts (50 visible), selected settings. No cleanup files, SQL deletion or SCM effects are simulated as measured native work.

deliveryArtifacts.semantics: OCI archive file bytes and package/EXE bytes; not unpacked container storage, container RSS, or Windows runtime measurements

notRun.name: linux_rootless_podman_quadlet_container_rss_cpu
notRun.reason: This command measures the current native host only; run the immutable release under rootless Podman + systemd/Quadlet on Linux for a deployment baseline

notRun.name: windows_server_2016_agent_idle_cleanup_scm_rss_cpu
